name: @node-ctypes/winrt
description: Typed Windows Runtime (WinRT) projections and .winmd TypeScript code generator for Node.js powered by @node-ctypes/comtypes and node-ctypes
author: Damiano Mazzella

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "tests/checks/*.test.ts" "tests/src/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:mirror: npm run build && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', '--test-concurrency=1', 'tests/checks/*.test.ts', 'tests/src/*.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_CTYPES_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS: '1' } }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.demo:winui3:gen: node dist/cli.js generate Windows.Foundation Microsoft.UI Microsoft.UI.Windowing Microsoft.UI.Xaml Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Markup Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media Microsoft.UI.Xaml.XamlTypeInfo --winapp --only Microsoft.UI.Xaml:Application,IApplicationOverrides,ResourceDictionary,Window,UIElement,FrameworkElement,IUIElement,IFrameworkElement --only Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media:SystemBackdrop,MicaBackdrop,ISystemBackdrop,IMicaBackdrop --only Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls:XamlControlsResources,NavigationView,NavigationViewItem,NavigationViewSelectionChangedEventArgs,ScrollViewer,TextBlock,TextBox,PasswordBox,NumberBox,AutoSuggestBox,Button,CheckBox,RadioButton,ToggleSwitch,Slider,ProgressBar,ProgressRing,RatingControl,InfoBar,Expander,ComboBox,ListView,ColorPicker,MenuFlyoutItem,ToggleMenuFlyoutItem,SplitButton --only Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives:ToggleButton,RepeatButton,IButtonBase,IRangeBase,IToggleButton,IRepeatButton,ISelector --out examples/winui3-gallery/winrt
scripts.demo:ocr:gen: node dist/cli.js generate Windows.Foundation Windows.Storage Windows.Storage.Streams Windows.Graphics.Imaging Windows.Media.Ocr --only Windows.Storage:StorageFile --only Windows.Storage.Streams:IRandomAccessStream --out examples/ocr-image/winrt
scripts.demo:toast:gen: node dist/cli.js generate Windows.Foundation Windows.Data.Xml.Dom Windows.UI.Notifications --only Windows.Data.Xml.Dom:XmlDocument --only Windows.UI.Notifications:ToastNotification,ToastNotificationManager,ToastNotifier --out examples/toast-notification/winrt
scripts.demo:ble:gen: node dist/cli.js generate Windows.Foundation Windows.Devices.Bluetooth.Advertisement --out examples/bluetooth-scan/winrt
scripts.demo:gen:all: npm run demo:winui3:gen && npm run demo:hello:gen && npm run demo:ocr:gen && npm run demo:toast:gen && npm run demo:ble:gen
